meta.title: DooDesch Support - Report a bug
meta.description: Report bugs and feedback for DooDesch's projects. Share only what you want - every hint helps.

header.title: Report a bug & share feedback
header.subtitle: Pick a project and describe what you noticed. Only a short title is required - everything else is optional. Even the smallest hint helps.

form.repoNoneHint: No matching project? No problem - we'll categorize it ourselves.
form.githubHint: You'll be taken to GitHub and post with your own account.
form.githubOpened: GitHub opened in a new tab - click "Submit new issue" there.
form.githubFallback: No tab opened? Open on GitHub.

placeholders.description: What happened? Describe it in as much detail as you like.
placeholders.expected: What did you expect to happen?
placeholders.environment: e.g. browser, operating system, device, version
placeholders.additional: Logs, links, a description of screenshots or any other context

form.contactHint: Only if you'd like us to reach you for follow-up questions. Added to the issue.

success.title: Thanks for your report!
success.message: Your hint has been created successfully. We'll take a look.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
errors.rateLimit: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.captcha: The spam check failed. Please reload the page.
